small_step_review.rationale: The shared file contains one frozen residual HGB recipe, safe numeric inference provenance and immutable source/parent/output boundaries; the31-line sibling selects the separately frozen matched11-column recipe. Existing fixed common runner only binds generation1, so its top-level run cannot execute these new candidate identities. Feature/scoring/KEEP/chronology logic is reused without editing it. Numeric fitted-state export is needed to independently check this nonlinear predictor without an unauthorized refit or unsafe object deserialization. Splitting this candidate into a third harness module would not separate another scientific effect.
small_step_review.parent_change_attribution: COMPOSITE_UNATTRIBUTABLE within C versus each linear parent: trainer/loss/representation change together. Do not claim isolated HGB model benefit.
small_step_review.controlled_information_comparison: Only after both valid results: B2-minus-B1 is paired same-trainer/same-budget2versus11 causal-input comparison, not a replacement KEEP rule.
